text:
cassie: quick UX review — users keep missing Export in Trace Inspector. proposal: surface a compact export affordance next to the correlation id rather than hiding it in the kebab.
rafa: +1. during oncall we need one-click export; kebab is too hidden.
mina: compromise idea: small export icon beside the id for quick single-trace exports + a full 'Export trace' button in the header for bulk/export-all flows. that preserves copy prominence.
oliver: accessibility note: icon must have an accessible name (aria-label="Export trace") and be keyboard focusable. opening export options should trap focus and close on Escape.
cassie: mock: [export icon] [copy id] <trace-id> — icon reveals quick menu (JSON/CSV). header keeps full Export trace for larger exports.
rafa: tooltip/copy tweak: change the copy tooltip from "Copied!" to "Trace ID copied" so it's explicit for clipboard readers.
mina: ops asked filename include date + short id: suggestion redwood-trace-20260323-1a2b3c4d.json (short id = first 8 chars). filename should be editable with helper copy under input: "We include the timestamp for you — edit if needed."
oliver: dev notes: add aria-live region announcing "Trace ID copied" and debounce announcements if clicked repeatedly. ensure visible keyboard focus styles (focus ring) and tab order.
cassie: a11y checklist: focus moves into dialog on open, focus returns to trigger on close, role=dialog + aria-modal present, Esc closes, and tab order in dialog: format radios -> include spans checkbox -> filename input -> Export (primary) -> Cancel. Export should be primary action.
mina: i'll own dialog copy and helper text updates.
rafa: i'll update Figma with header export and icon placement; will also adjust tooltip copy.
oliver: i'll add aria labels and focus behavior to the prototype and update CSS tokens for keyboard-only focus.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled to staging at 2026-03-23T18:00Z for branch trace-inspector-export-nits.
cassie: tiny copy nits: dialog title -> "Export trace" (not just "Export"). confirm action text -> "Export" not "OK". i'll add note to staging release notes about filename change. reconvene after staging smoke tests. :thumbsup:
